name: com.esearchcy/esearchcy
title: ESearchCy — Cyprus company search
description: Search Cyprus companies: status, registration date, registered office, officers count, documents.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find Cyprus companies and partnerships registered with the Registrar of Companies, by registration number (e.g. "HE 123456", "ΗΕ 123456", "S 1817") or by the start of the registered name (e.g. "BANK OF CYPRUS"). Returns name, number, status, registration date and the company page link. Includes struck-off and dissolved companies.

query.description: Registration number, or the beginning of the company name (Latin or Greek).

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Registry details of one Cyprus company or partnership: name, type, status and its date, registration date, registered office address, number and roles of current officers (no names), the date of the open data, and links to the company page and to order its documents.

number.description: Registration number, e.g. "HE 123456" or "S 1817". A bare number means a company (HE).

tools.name: get_documents_and_prices
tools.description: What ESearchCy can order from the Cyprus Registrar of Companies — the complete company file (every scanned document as PDF) and official certificates (incorporation, shareholders, directors and secretary, registered office, good standing, share capital, no winding-up, memorandum and articles) — with prices, delivery times and how to order.
